title: Integrating Sustainable Development Goals in Everyday Work
description: This job aid identifies opportunities to proactively apply the Sustainable Development Goals, set by the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, across government policies, programs, and operations.

competencies.competency: Thinking Things Through (Create Vision and Strategy)
competencies.description: Thinking Things Through is the ability to systematically analyze problems, identify patterns and connections, and develop well-informed plans and recommendations. This competency involves asking the right questions, evaluating cause and effect relationships, and turning analysis into clear strategies that align with organizational goals.
indicators: Ask the right questions to identify relevant problems/issues.
Frame questions explicitly for data to inform answers.
Consult with appropriate authorities to identify what constitutes high-quality evidence.
Recognize connections and develop short-term plans and recommendations.
Use cause and effect relationships to analyze problems systematically.
Resolve problems in a sound, logical and decisive manner.

competencies.description: Business acumen in data science refers to the ability to understand and apply knowledge of business operations, strategy, and decision-making processes. It involves identifying business needs, aligning data-driven insights with organizational goals, and making decisions that drive organizational success.
indicators: Demonstrate basic understanding of key business functions, such as marketing, finance, and operations, and how they relate to data science projects.
Recognize business problems and basic opportunities where data analysis can contribute to business goals.
Understand key financial metrics (e.g., revenue, profit margins, cost structures) and how they impact business decisions.
Present data findings in simple terms, ensuring they are relevant and understandable for business stakeholders.
Recognize various data types and value as an organizational asset.

title: Integrating Sustainable Development Goals into Policy Making
description: This job aid lists key questions to consider when incorporating the principles of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and its Sustainable Development Goals for developing, implementing, and evaluating government policies, programs, and initiatives.

title: Tips for Having Constructive Performance Conversations
description: This job aid provides tips on how to have constructive performance conversations with employees.

competencies.competency: Working Effectively with Others (Mobilize People; Collaborate with Partners and Stakeholders)
competencies.description: Working Effectively with Others is the ability to build strong, collaborative relationships within and outside the organization. It involves sharing information openly, encouraging diverse viewpoints, and enabling teamwork to solve problems and achieve shared goals. This competency extends to supporting others through change, providing constructive feedback, mobilizing teams around a common purpose, and fostering partnerships that amplify organizational effectiveness.
indicators: Share relevant information to facilitate collaboration.
Accomplish independent tasks as part of one's own share of the work.
Work with others to clearly define problems and identify suitable solutions.
Suggest methods and means for maximizing the input and involvement of team members.
Facilitate the expression of diverse points of view to enhance teamwork.
Openly share data/findings to support other teams' work.

title: Action Verbs for More Precise S.M.A.R.T. Objectives
description: This job aid presents a list of action verbs to help make your work and learning objectives as precise as possible.

competencies.description: Project Management in the context of data science involves planning, organizing, and overseeing data-driven projects from initiation to completion. It includes managing resources, timelines, and deliverables while ensuring that project goals align with business objectives. It also involves risk management, stakeholder communication, and iterative problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle.
indicators: Assist in planning project tasks and timelines, and ensure milestones are met under direct supervision.
Help allocate resources (time, people, tools) for simple tasks or project phases.
Understand and follow project timelines and task lists.
Identify simple project risks, such as timeline delays or resource shortages, and raise awareness with the team.
Contribute to maintaining project documentation (e.g., status reports, project timelines) and keep records updated.

competencies.competency: Showing Initiative and Being Action Oriented (Achieve Results; Promote Innovation and Guide Change)
competencies.description: Showing Initiative and Being Action Oriented is the ability to proactively accomplish tasks, adapt to shifting priorities, and effectively plan to achieve results even when faced with challenges. It includes anticipating and overcoming obstacles, driving projects forward, and using resourcefulness to both improve performance and promote innovation. This competency extends to encouraging experimentation and new ideas, demonstrating resilience amid change, and taking ownership for outcomes.
indicators: Accomplish own share of work
Respond to changes in organizational priority, revising own work when conditions change
Plan for contingencies to deal with unforeseen events or setbacks
Break activities into smaller components to facilitate completion

title: What to Do in Case of Extended Sick Leave
description: This job aid provides a list of responsibilities for employees who must take sick leave for more than 10 consecutive work days.
